note: Scripture source: the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, CC BY-SA 4.0), parsed from the ebible mirror's USX (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv), all 66 books (31,104 verses), with section headings, notes, speaker labels and the IRV's trailing cross-reference parentheses stripped. Translators looked up every quotation, cited or not, in that verse file.
Translated from the English fixture, which already carries the settled text (corrections.settled_chapter_body changes nothing for this slug).

Derived by measurement: a row is mined only when the translated block contains a 30-character run of that IRV verse (whole verse if shorter; 16 characters where the translator reported the quotation verbatim, since Watson quotes half-verses constantly), compared with quotation marks, punctuation and spaces stripped, AND the translator did not list it as self-rendered. References come from the English citations (ranges over 3 verses keep only the verses the Hindi verifiably contains) plus the translators' own uncited-quotation lists. 241 of 464 rows mined.

Conventions: curly quotation marks mirror the English block by block; reader address तुम (precedent a-call-to-the-unconverted.hi); 'the godly' भक्त; 'desertion' परमेश्वर का मुख छिपाना (after IRV Isaiah 54:8); 'effectual calling' प्रभावशाली बुलाहट; 'conversion' मन-फिराव; Watson's Roman sub-heads (i.), (ii.) kept as in the English, his (a), (b) as (क), (ख).

IRV/KJV divergences the translators flagged (self-rendered, for review): Acts 9:6 ('Lord, what wilt thou have me to do?' absent from IRV), Matt 20:16 ('many are called, but few chosen' absent; IRV Matt 22:14 wording used under Watson's 20:16 citation), Hos 7:11 ('without heart'), Phil 3:14 ('high calling'), Ps 35:13 ('returned into mine own bosom'), 1 Kgs 3:9 ('understanding heart'), Heb 2:10 ('Captain of salvation'), John 17:15 ('the evil' vs IRV 'the evil one'), Prov 8:17 (IRV feminine verb kept though Watson applies it to God). Six quotations where the IRV puts extra words inside Watson's shorter quote (Isa 57:16, 57:17, Judg 18:24, Ps 97:11, Ps 119:127, 2 Tim 1:9) were joined without an ellipsis and are self-rendered.
